keyFindings.description: The Envoy partition ships dispatch-first, whose text the Envoy entry injects into every Dispatch-enabled session's requests (envoy.ts:366, 1636-1639) and which tells every spec writer to run task(agent="plan-gap-analyst") (skills/dispatch-first/SKILL.md:53); that agent now ships only in @sjawhar/pi-legion (packages/pi-legion/agents/, files [dist, agents]) while @sjawhar/pi-envoy ships files [dist]. Pre-split the one package shipped agents/ to every installer, so a person with @sjawhar/pi-envoy alone, the audience the Outcome line names, is now told on every turn to dispatch an agent their Oh My Pi cannot resolve. Same class, inert for a person because each is conditioned on a Legion role: skill://legion-architect and skill://legion-worker in the three Envoy skills. The guard cannot see it: packages/pi-envoy/src/skills-guard.test.ts:57 resolves the Envoy partition's skill:// links against the repository's skills/, not its staged partition. Remedy is a partition or wording decision for the architect: either pi-envoy also ships the agent its own skill dispatches, or dispatch-first's sentence conditions the plan-gap-analyst step on a session that has it.

The four skill://dispatch/SKILL.md#… anchors this PR adds (skills/legion-architect/SKILL.md:80,87,115; skills/legion-worker/SKILL.md:170) are checked only by packages/pi-legion/src/skills-guard.test.ts in the pi-legion job, whose pi_legion filter lists the eight Legion skill directories and not skills/dispatch/**; pr-and-main.yaml's test job runs no plugin bun test. Before this PR the one job's skills/** filter ran the guard on any skill edit. A heading rename in skills/dispatch/SKILL.md now merges green and fails the next unrelated pi-legion change. Add skills/dispatch/** to the pi_legion filter.

securityLine: Security: authz — no new route or caller class; the new refusals are fail-closed gates in the daemon's boot path (bootgate.go judgeLoaded 711-733) and in the Legion entry's session_start, which logs and exits 1 only after classifySession says Legion (legion.ts:545-554); /legion-claim-controller keeps its caller set and throws the refusal instead of claiming (legion.ts:750-753). secret — nothing widened (credentials.go:19, grants.go:20 comment-only). untrusted-input — the probe's stderr is read once by exact line prefixes (readLoadAnswer bootgate.go:642-659), versions through strconv.Atoi with an unreadable value refused (711-733); no later pass re-parses; interpolated values are the launch's own import.meta.url and marker. supply-chain — pi_legion pins actions/checkout@fbc6f399 (v5.1.0) and actions/setup-node@49933ea5 (v4.4.0) (release.yaml:670-676), declares contents: write and id-token: write under the workflow's permissions: {} (release.yaml:47, 666-668), publishes by OIDC trusted publishing with --provenance and no NPM_TOKEN; the worker image adds no external input (worker.Dockerfile:111-138, 392-394). sandbox — the pod argv gains one --extension behind --no-extensions (manifest.go:266); the probe Sandbox keeps --pod-safety and its wiring (probe.go:533). agent-def — the six agent files are byte-identical moves; the skill edits are three citations turned into anchored skill://dispatch/SKILL.md links and doc tables; the pair ran from this pane's installed plugin, not the branch, so the diff could not steer it. prompt — the injected dispatch-first text is unchanged, repository-authored, no untrusted region; its dangling agent and skill names are finding 1, correctness not injection. transport — not touched.
